mapper.select: SELECT 'daily-report' AS feature, status, COUNT(*) AS job_count, MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN started_at ELSE created_at END) AS oldest_at, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED' AND last_published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconfirmed_publication_count FROM daily_report_generation_job GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'combination-review', status, COUNT(*), MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN execution_started_at ELSE started_at END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED' AND last_published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM combination_review_run WHERE queue_expires_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'application-form-discovery', status, COUNT(*), MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN started_at ELSE created_at END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED' AND last_published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM application_form_discovery_job GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'daily-report-delivery', CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE delivery_status END, COUNT(*), MIN(CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'SENDING' THEN delivery_started_at ELSE delivery_queued_at END), SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' AND delivery_last_published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM daily_report WHERE delivery_queued_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_status UNION ALL SELECT 'account-oauth-unlink', status, COUNT(*), MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN started_at ELSE created_at END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED' AND last_published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM account_oauth_unlink_job GROUP BY status
